claims.text: The dataset was constructed from Tatoeba, collecting (speech, transcript, English translation) triplets for five languages, filtering by sentence length and quality.
Common Voice was used to gather validated voice clips from contributors reading sentences, ensuring diverse speaker representation.
The dataset includes quality checks such as BLEU scores and manual inspections to ensure translation accuracy.
